Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that the first elected position of the official before Steven C. Johnson (Lynn Rogers) was "Wichita School Board member." The Predicted Answer claims that Lynn Rogers' first elected office was as a "Kansas state senator, representing the 25th District, beginning in 2001." These are different positions; the Predicted Answer does not mention the "Wichita School Board" role at all. Therefore, the substance and vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer are not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
